name: singlet_evaluation_cluster_validity_indices
title: Label-free cluster validity indices
description: Scores candidate cluster partitions of the same cells with geometric validity indices (silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, Calinski-Harabasz) in one shared embedding, and optionally with scIB label and batch silhouette terms. Writes per-partition scores, per-cell silhouette and a granularity flag under uns/cluster_validity. Use it to compare partitions from one embedding; it does not establish biological validity, which needs held-out labels or planted structure. Do not treat the label-based terms as label-free evidence.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

embedding.description: obsm key of the embedding used for every distance; all partitions share it.

cluster_keys.description: obs columns holding candidate partitions, one per resolution or k; all scored on the same cells.

indices.description: Indices to compute. asw_label and asw_batch need scib_asw keys and are label-based comparators.

metric.description: Distance for silhouette and scIB terms; a scikit-learn metric name.

min_clusters.description: Smallest number of clusters in a partition considered for scoring.

silhouette.description: Options for the silhouette index and its support flag.

sample_size.description: Subsample size for approximate silhouette; null computes the exact value.

support_threshold.description: Mean silhouette below which the flag reports unsupported granularity; proposed, uncalibrated.

scib_asw.description: Label and batch keys for the scIB terms.

label_key.description: obs column of annotation labels; required for asw_label and benchmark B1.

batch_key.description: obs column of batch labels; required for asw_batch.

seed.description: Seed for subsampling and k-means initialisation.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/<name>_silhouette. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Per partition: cluster count and index values; chosen partition, supported flag and smallest cluster size. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
